[Benzinga news, 2026-10-28T14:01:37Z, by staff] Smurfit Westrock Reports Q3 2026 Financial Results and Lowers Full-Year Outlook
Smurfit Westrock reported third-quarter 2026 financial results that missed analyst expectations and announced a reduction in its full-year earnings outlook.
Smurfit Westrock plc reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $8.16 billion, falling short of the FactSet consensus estimate of $8.29 billion. The company also posted an adjusted earnings per share of $0.45, which was below the expected $0.61. Alongside these results, management slashed the company's full-year 2026 earnings outlook. Additionally, the Board of Directors approved a quarterly dividend of $0.4523 per share, payable on December 10, 2026, to shareholders of record as of November 13, 2026.
